audit_items.proof_trace: After pruning data columns, only BlobInfo.oldest_blob_slot is updated (L3272-3278), but DataColumnInfo.oldest_data_column_slot is never updated. This causes stale metadata that misrepresents the actual retention boundary, leading to incorrect responses for data column range requests.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Peers query for data columns within the advertised range (based on stale oldest_data_column_slot) but receive InvalidRequest errors because the data was pruned. This violates the spec requirement to serve data within MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.
